name: Citizen dialogue group for suspension bridge planning in Rottweil 2016
content: Problems and Purpose Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities The Konstanz office "translake" moderated the pedestrian suspension bridge's dialogue group. [1] Participant Recruitment and Selection 50 randomly selected citizens were invited to participate in the process with the investor, representatives of the residents, the municipal council, the administration and authorities;15 places were provided for this. [1]In this way, if there were more interested parties, the lot would decide; if fewer people signed up to participate in the dialogue process, other citizens would be invited.
